hook: Label, train and auto-label on your Mac

beats.say: A developer needed an on-device model to detect playing cards on iPhone, so he built labelkit, a free native Mac app.
You draw boxes fast, train with Create ML, then let the model label the rest. The demo goes from labels to auto labeling in 38 seconds.
Saves are byte stable for clean git diffs, tens of thousands of images open instantly, and a ten thousand image dataset idles at around 20 megabytes of memory.
